name: Attacca
description: Attacca is a multi-agent coding orchestrator. Manager plans, Engineer builds, Security audits, you ship. Seven Specialists, one workplace.
longDescription:
Ships **8 skills** and **7 agents**.

- **Skills** (8): `code-review` (On-demand code review checklist), `incident-response`, `quality-gate` (Pre-push quality gate checklist), `sbom` (Generate a real Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) using syft or cdxgen and pipe output to Security agent…), `security-audit` (On-demand security audit checklist based on OWASP Top 10), `supply-chain` (4-gate supply chain security defense for any project with dependencies), `tdd` (TDD workflow skill enforcing RED → GREEN → REFACTOR), `update-workspace-map` (Auto-regenerate .agents/workspace-map.md after any file changes)
- **Agents** (7): `consultant` (Deep architectural reasoning agent (expensive — use sparingly)), `critic` (Code quality advisor), `designer` (UI/UX reviewer and design spec generator), `engineer` (Code implementation agent), `medic` (SEV 1 emergency incident responder), `researcher` (Competitive analysis and market research agent), `security` (Adversarial security auditor)

Installs with `claude plugin install attacca@claude-community` from `adihebbalae/Attacca`.
